units.source_text: 至于去五番町的事，不消说我是不会做于做卫生上的准备的。

en.t: As for going to Gobancho, needless to say, I would not make any sanitary preparations.

units.source_text: 前一天，我就到远处的一家不熟悉的药房去买了橡胶制品，

en.t: The day before, I went to an unfamiliar pharmacy far away and bought rubber goods,

units.source_text: 那粉末的薄膜带着一种多么无力的、不健康的颜色。

en.t: and that powdery thin membrane had such a feeble, unhealthy color.

units.source_text: 昨夜我曾将其中的一个试用了。

en.t: Last night I had tried using one of them.

units.source_text: 用老红粉错笔画的调清的佛画、

en.t: A Buddhist picture of Chosei drawn with an awkward brush in old rouge powder,

units.source_text: 京都观光协会的日历、打开正好是佛顶尊胜陀罗尼这一页禅林日课的经文、

en.t: a Kyoto Tourism Association calendar, a Zen daily service text opened exactly to the page of the Butcho Sonsho Dharani,

units.source_text: 肮脏的袜子、起倒戗刺的铺席……这些东西中，

en.t: dirty socks, and a mat with splinters sticking up and down... among these things,

units.source_text: 我的那个玩意儿像一尊光滑的、灰色的、无眼无鼻的、不吉利的佛像竖立起来了。

en.t: that thing of mine rose up like a smooth, gray, eyeless and noseless, ill-omened Buddhist statue.

units.source_text: 这种不痛快的姿态，使我联想起至今还流传下来的"罗切"②这种残酷的行为。

en.t: This unpleasant posture made me think of the cruel practice called "rache," which has been handed down to this day.
